name: Halloween Nanka Dai Kirai
original_name: ハロウィンなんかだいきらい
source:
One Halloween night, on the outskirts of "Demon King's Hill," a town inhabited by magicians and other mysterious creatures.

The main character, a young girl named Sentence, enjoys using magic to make what resembles message bottles. Today, on her way home from helping a girl in her class, she is sending out letters near the "Colorless Forest," believing that they would reach her missing childhood friend, "Sent".

Then, she remembers rumors of a monster...?

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16095]Freem![/url]]
translation:
万圣节之夜，“魔王之丘”郊外，一座居住着魔法师和其他神秘生物的小镇。

主角是一个名叫Sentence的小女孩，喜欢用魔法制作类似留言瓶的东西。今天，在帮助班上一个女孩回家的路上，她正在“无色森林”附近寄出信件，相信这些信件会到达她失踪的儿时朋友“发送者”那里。

然后，她想起了怪物的传闻……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/16095]Freem![/url]]
